description:
## What
Add a private helper `cert_name_constraints(cert) -> Option<NameConstraints>` in pkix-path/src/lib.rs that extracts and decodes the NameConstraints extension from a certificate.

## Algorithm
- Iterate `cert.tbs_certificate.extensions` (if Some)
- Match on OID_NAME_CONSTRAINTS (2.5.29.30)
- Decode the extension value as `x509_cert::ext::pkix::constraints::name::NameConstraints`
- Return Some(nc) on success, None if absent; propagate decode errors as OcspParseError or equivalent

## Acceptance criteria
- Returns Some(nc) for CA certs with NameConstraints
- Returns None for EE certs and certs without the extension
- Decode error surfaces as Err rather than silently returning None
title: Add cert_name_constraints() extractor helper
